title: Rotten Riches
body:
# Intro
Tired of having too much USELESS rotten flesh?
Well, tire no more!

The Rotten Riches mod allows you to craft a diamond from nine rotten flesh!!
I mean, who doesn't like literal FREE DIAMONDS?? 🤑

# Version
The Rotten Riches mod is only compatible with 1.21.11 Fabric at the moment and will be updated for newer versions soon...
